# Hmar Heritage Foundation

> An independent foundation dedicated to digital stewardship, language standardization, open AI datasets, software locales, and digital literature archives for the Hmar language (`hmr`).

## Identity & Purpose

The Hmar Heritage Foundation is an open digital stewardship organization dedicated to preserving cultural heritage, compiling open datasets, standardizing software locales, and maintaining community lexicons.

## Core Pages

- [Home & Founder Statement](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/index.md)): Foundation overview, founder statement, economic justification, and foundational principles.
- [Foundational Philosophy](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/philosophy) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/philosophy.md)): 10-section essay on scope, realism, quiet groundwork, and generational preservation.
- [Language Standards & Taxonomy Policy](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/standards) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/standards.md)): Official position paper on linguistic taxonomy, replacing colonial exonyms with the Zo autonym.
- [Charter & Constitution](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/manifesto) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/manifesto.md)): Statutory Articles of Governance and anti-paywall protections.
- [Digital Archival Projects](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects.md)): Overview of literature archives, software locales, open lexicons, and Wikipedia Incubator.
- [People & Governance](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/people) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/people.md)): Leadership team, operational leads, and advisory council.

## Key Projects

- [Hmar Digital Library](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/library) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/library.md)): Digital archive for classic literature, rare manuscripts, and folk songbooks.
- [Open Locale Project](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/locale) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/locale.md)): Multi-platform software localization keys and staging workflows.
- [Hmar Heritage Archival Project](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/archival) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/archival.md)): Bulk text corpora, speech audio, and dataset mirrors on Hugging Face.
- [Hmar Wikipedia Incubator Initiative](https://incubator.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wp/hmr) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/wikipedia.md)): Encyclopedic development on Wikimedia Incubator (Wp/hmr).
- [Hmar Open Lexicon](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/lexicon) ([Markdown](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/lexicon.md)): Standardized technical glossaries and open lexical databases.

## External Resources

- [Official Website](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev): Main web portal and digital archives.
- [Founder Website](https://thingpuisen.pages.dev): Personal blog and notes of founder Donal Muolhoi.
- [Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/hmar-heritage-org): Open datasets hub for wordlist, corpus-archive, and zo-bible.
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/hmar-heritage-org): Open-source code repositories, software locales, and open schemas.
- [Sitemap](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap index.

## Licensing

Archived materials are open for research, community education, and language technology, maintaining full credit to original authors, translators, and lexicographers. Standalone commercial paywalling or resale of raw archival data is strictly prohibited.
